name: opencode
description: SST's open-source terminal coding agent: runs shell commands and edits files in a working directory to complete a task.
command: export HOME=/tmp && cd /work && exec opencode run -m openai/gpt-4o-mini "$SMADP_AGENT_TASK"
notes: Locally-built image (FROM node:22-slim + `npm install -g opencode-ai`), approved by local image id. Runs headless via `opencode run -m openai/gpt-4o-mini`; the task is delivered through SMADP_AGENT_TASK and opencode acts on the mounted /work directory.
